name: zt-idea-grow
description: Grow the ZET Topic trees from the Literature trees of the whole card box, as Luhmann wrote his main-box Cards from all his bibliographic notes: DeepSeek reads each section of every Literature tree against the whole box (the Topic Cards and the other books' notes) and keeps the core, related, useful, interesting and intuitive ideas as standalone Topic-tree Cards filed beside the Cards they continue, one concept gathering its ideas from several sources; zt-digest grow plans the run's Topics, checks, writes, links across trees, fixes, reviews each source book's term table against the Topics, optionally merges duplicate Topics and moves misplaced Topic Cards, builds the hubs and the register for the grown Topics, and reports the Topic share per book. Since 3.0.0 it is the only workflow that writes Topic trees, Topic Cards, hubs and the register: the digests build only Literature trees
whenToUse: When the box holds Literature trees (from the digests or written by hand, either Workspace): give a fresh work folder, and optionally book or books to narrow it; by default every Literature tree of the box is read, so the more books the box holds, the more each idea can relate to. Writes only agent Topic trees, their hubs and the register; the digests write only Literature trees, so run this after a digest to grow its Topics. Mode hubs rebuilds the hubs and the register alone (no new Card; the concept review of the books' term tables still feeds the register): give a fresh work folder, and optionally book or books, hubTrees, hubRebuild, hubLimits. organize: true adds the Topic maintenance round (duplicate-Topic merges, misplaced-Card moves) before the hubs. Not for building a Literature tree.

preflight.P1: Goal and result: the reader's own ideas from the box's Literature trees, written as agent Topic-tree Cards that relate them to each other (docs/idea-grow-design.md; the Topic proposals P1-P7 of docs/topic-tree-ideas-proposals.md live here, not in the digests). The box is the unit (user, 2026-10-20): not one book at a time. Result: the plan line (books, sections, left for a rerun), the run Topics, rounds, the report line (Cards, Topics, Links, bridges across books, same, refused, duplicates, faults left, Topic share before and after) and the cleaned workspaces; grow-report.md (with the share per book) in the work folder. 3.0.0 (docs/literature-only-digest-design.md): the owner moved the idea compose, the Topic-tree compose and the hub compose out of every digest; the digests now build only Literature trees and this workflow is the only one that writes Topic trees, Topic Cards, hubs and the register.
preflight.P2: Inputs: out (the work folder, required; also the DeepSeek workspace); books (Citation keys) or book (one key), both optional: without them every Literature tree of the box (both Workspaces); from/to (an optional anchor range); fixRounds (0-2, default 1); dshModel (default the official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash source, deepseek-official/deepseek-flash: the user wants the official source only); effort (high or max; never lower). At most 120 sections per run: the rest is reported as left and a rerun with the same out takes it. 2.2.0: ztConfig (the ZT_CONFIG_DIR of a copy of the box; every step and the DeepSeek helper line set it, so the run reads and writes only that copy) and tool (a zt-digest binary, so a development build never replaces the installed one under another run). 2.5.0: hubs (default true) and register (apply, plan, off; default apply). 3.0.0: the hub options the digests had (hubTrees, hubRebuild, hubLimits, hubEffort, hubFixRounds) and restate (default true). 3.1.0: concepts (default true: the concept review of each source book's term table, the register plan's -Review), organize (default false: the Topic maintenance round) and organizeTrees (the Topics it surveys; empty: the run's own).
preflight.P3: Units of work: first one Topic-planning job over every section of every book (gt-001: the anchors grouped by book and the Topic catalogue; it reuses agent Topics and opens at most max(2, ceil(sections/2)) <= 8 new ones), then one section per DeepSeek job: an anchor of a Literature tree (Key/n) with its subtree, or a whole tree that has no anchor; each section file also lists the closest notes of the other books. zt-digest grow -Step plan writes gt-001 and the section files; -Step topics makes the run's Topics and writes jobs\gw-NNN.md with them; each step prints only counts, and the module names the jobs gw-001..gw-N. Fix jobs are one per section with faults (fxR-NNN), from -Step check's count. 2.5.0: the hubs round wraps each hub compiler job as a grow job (gh-NNN; fix jobs gh<round>-NNN) from -Step hubs-plan and -Step hubs-check, which print counts only. 3.1.0: the concept review is one judge job per source book with an agent term-table Card (cNN-cj; grow -Step concept-books stages at most 24 books: the named ones in mode hubs, else the books the run grew Cards from, else every agent book with a term table); the Topic maintenance round is one decision job (go-001) over the survey of the run's Topics. 3.2.0 (zt-grow-cycle v11): the restatement and concept reviews prepare every book first, then send all the books' judge jobs (rNN-rj, cNN-cj) in one DeepSeek dispatch, side by side under the DSMP limits (8 per manager, 8 managers), then judge, apply and report each book in order; a book whose prepare fails is skipped alone.
preflight.P4: Roles: runner (Haiku, low) relays each zt-digest grow command and returns its last line; DSMP managers (Haiku, fixed by the protocol) run up to 8 DeepSeek conversations each, at most 8 at once, approve only the read-only helper, the precheck, reads under the work folder and JSON writes under out, and delete every conversation. DeepSeek (official source, high effort, skills zettelkasten and asd-ste100-zh) writes only its answer file. No Sonnet or Opus role: scripts plan, check and write.
preflight.P5: Stage graph: grow (one module stage: plan -> DeepSeek topic plan -> topics -> DeepSeek ideas -> apply -> links -> DeepSeek link jobs -> apply -> check/fix rounds -> hubs plan -> DeepSeek hub jobs -> hubs apply -> hubs check/fix rounds -> hubs report and register -> report -> cleanup) -> report (value). The rounds are sequential inside the module because each apply needs every answer of its round, and the section jobs need the run's Topics. 3.0.0: after the check/fix rounds and before the hubs, the restatement review of the run's new Topic Cards (grow -Step restate-cards writes one staging folder per source book; zt-digest restate prepare -> one DeepSeek judge job per book -> judge -> apply under the run's own operation prefix grow-<folder>/restate-rNN/1/apply -> report). Mode hubs runs grow with only the hubs round (hubs plan with the hub options -> hub jobs at hubEffort -> apply -> hubFixRounds check/fix rounds -> hubs report and register) -> report. 3.1.0: after the restatement review, the optional Topic maintenance round (grow -Step organize-plan: organize-survey -Topics -> DeepSeek go-001 decides the merges and moves as JSON -> grow -Step organize-apply: the answer checked again, the valid decisions carried out by organize-apply -Open, the run's addresses renamed); then, before the hubs (mode full and mode hubs), the concept review per source book (grow -Step concept-books -> zt-digest concepts propose -> prepare -> DeepSeek cNN-cj -> judge -> report) and hubs-report -Concepts, whose register plan reads every rendered report as -Review (zt-digest register reads several reports separated by ;).
preflight.P6: Modules: zt-grow-cycle v8 (project folder scripts/idea-grow/workflow/modules; requires the framework's script, deepseek and the DSMP block) and value. The prompt template is scripts/idea-grow/dsh-grow-instructions.zh.md, read by -Step plan from disk. 2.3.0: zt-grow-cycle v7 adds the Tree Lock seam (#140): a grow step or DeepSeek job the owner's Lock refused answers the tool's typed `card_locked` JSON, and the stage stops with it, keeping the Topic Cards already filed and the answer files. 3.0.0: zt-grow-cycle v9 adds mode hubs, the hub options and the restatement round; zt-digest grow adds -Step restate-cards and hubs-plan -Limits/-Trees/-Rebuild (zt-digest 0.10.0, whose digest steps run in the Literature scope). 3.1.0: zt-grow-cycle v10 adds the concept round and the Topic maintenance round; zt-digest grow adds -Step concept-books, organize-plan, organize-apply, the go-NNN precheck (O1-O8) and hubs-report -Concepts; organize-survey adds -Topics (a survey of named Topics, no book); register -Review takes several reports (zt-digest 0.11.0). 3.2.0: zt-grow-cycle v11 (the batched per-book judge jobs; skipped_on_copy). The prompt adds the guidance for a mathematics textbook's sections: a unit's statement, hypotheses and proof stay in the Literature tree; Topic Cards state the idea behind it and link the unit with 例示/对应/对照/特例, never 依赖.
preflight.P7: Checks: every DeepSeek job runs its SELF-CHECK (zt-digest grow -Step precheck: G1-G13, with Link kinds read as zt reads them, one root placement per section and Topic (G13), and zt-check on the drafts; the topic job: ids, existing agent roots, near names, sections, the bound) until faults: 0, and its answer must end OK or FLAG; apply validates every answer again and refuses each idea with a fault; check runs zt-check --cards with each Card's own book on every Card the run wrote and turns each hard fault into a fix job; the grow stage expects a report. 2.5.0: each hub job runs the hub compiler's own precheck on every JSON file it writes (grow -Step precheck -Job gh-NNN sums them); hubs-check reads get_hub on every hub and turns each writer's faults into a fix job; the register is published only when its plan has no fault, and read back. 3.1.0: the decision job go-001 runs its SELF-CHECK (grow -Step precheck -Job go-001: O1 shape and reasons, O2 unknown Card, O3 not a surveyed Topic root, O4 a Card that never moves, O5 a Locked Topic, O6 a destination outside the kept Topic or inside the moved Card, O7 Card notes, O8 a Topic dropped twice); organize-apply checks the answer again and drops each faulty decision; organize-apply itself plans every move with the archive first (Lock, pins, Links). Each concept judge job runs zt-digest concepts -Step judge as its self-check; the report is rendered from the frozen files alone.
preflight.P8: Failure policy, modes, checkpoints: grow retries 0 (a rerun with the same out resumes: applied sections are skipped, their answers kept) and halts; report always runs after grow. A destination the owner locked is not a retryable fault: the stage stops with the typed `card_locked` refusal and keeps the Cards it already filed (R326/R337). Mode hubs (3.0.0): the hubs round and the register alone, on the live box only; no checkpoints. A restatement review that fails for one book is reported for that book and the run goes on. The DeepSeek cleanup runs in a finally block. 3.1.0: a concept review that fails for one book is reported for that book and the run goes on (the register plan reads the reports that were rendered); a Topic maintenance decision the archive refuses is reported as refused or blocked, and a Lock that appears during it stops the stage with the typed card_locked refusal. 3.2.0: on a copy of the box (ztConfig) the live-box rounds (restatement review, Topic maintenance, concept review, hubs and register) do not run, and the log and the result (skipped_on_copy) name them.
preflight.P9: Dry run and pilot: zt-idea-grow.sim.json stands in for plan (2 sections), the topic manager, topics (2 jobs), one manager, apply, check (one fix), report and cleanup. Pilot 1 (1.0.0, 2026-10-20): 8 sections of grossman2002integration, 53 Topic Cards, Topic share 1.6% -> 47.4%, 0 faults left, but 8 new Topics (4 on one concept) and every related idea branched off the one earlier Topic Card; 1.1.0 plans the run's Topics first, appends a root-direct idea to the main line, and reads Link kinds as zt does (G10). Pilot 2 (1.1.0): 4 run Topics (3 new, 379/0 reused), 58 Topic Cards, 0 faults, share 49.6%, 5 min; but the main-line append joined five parallel sections into one blind 20-step chain in 389. 1.2.0: a later root placement opens a line beside the doorway (n/1|a …), and the section chains its ideas in it. Pilot 3 (1.2.0): 4 run Topics, 56 Topic Cards, each Topic a doorway with one line per section (391/1|a..f), 0 faults, share 48.7%; but only 6 of 56 Cards linked another Topic tree, all to the one earlier Card 379/1. 1.3.0 adds the link round: one DeepSeek job per Topic tree the run wrote in (gl-NNN), Links to Cards of other trees, at most 2 per Card, each one sentence with its kind (G11), appended to the Card. 2.0.0 (user, 2026-10-20: not locked on one Literature tree): by default every Literature tree of the box; the topic plan groups sections by book; each section lists the closest notes of other books; checks use each section's own book; the report counts bridges (Topic Cards citing two or more books) and the share per book. Pilot 4: the whole box in a fresh folder, e.g. {out: "D:\zt-grow\box-pilot4"}; back up the archive first. Pilot 4 (2.0.0, the whole box: grossman2002integration and the human sylla2018alexander): 9 sections, 4 run Topics (3 new, 379/0 reused), 57 Topic Cards, 32 Links across trees, 0 faults, share 6.3% -> 50.4%, 10 min; the Hamilton section continued the user's own human Cards (承接 [[0/1|a]], 印证 [[0/1|a|1]]); but the link round appended its sentences after the source line, and a public-credit Topic offered only outsourcing Cards wrote forced analogies. 2.1.0: the Link sentence goes before the source line (edit with base), the link candidates must share wording with the tree's new Cards (a tree with none gets no job), and the prompt asks an analogy to name the shared mechanism. 2.2.0 (user, 2026-10-20: develop idea-grow on a copy of the box while a digest runs on the live one): ztConfig and tool. Pilot 5: the copy D:zt-grow-box (config D:zt-grow-boxconfig, archive D:zt-grow-boxarchive), tool D:zt-grow-targetdebugzt-digest.exe. Pilot 5 (2.2.0, on the copy, 8 min, 15 conversations deleted): 9 sections of 2 books, 5 run Topics (4 new, 379/0 reused), 54 Topic Cards, 42 Links across trees (before the source line), 1 same, 0 faults, share 6.3% -> 49.2%, 0 bridges (the two books share no mechanism); the public-credit Topic wrote 2 Links (one to the user's human Card), not 4 forced ones. 2.2.1: no working folder for the steps (the plan step ran before the folder existed). 2.3.0: the Tree Lock seam (zt-grow-cycle v7) and the instructions' rule that a `card_locked` refusal is final, never retried. Live run (2.3.0, 2026-10-22, D:/zt-grow/live-2026-10-22): 62 Cards, 0 faults, Topic share 11.9% -> 57%, but Topic 412 gathered 9 lines beside its doorway 412/1 (one section put 3 ideas at the root). 2.4.0 (zt-digest 0.9.1, module unchanged): G13 allows one root placement per section and Topic, and a doorway with 7 lines sends the next root placement beside its last line; the report lists those Cards (deeper). 2.5.0 (user, 2026-10-22: the hubs were not well developed or linked): the live box had one field hub and a register whose 37 terms all pointed at Topic roots, and the grown Topics 412-414 were in no hub (list_hubs: missing topic hubs for 412 and 413, a line hub for 412/1, 208 Cards unreached). The hubs round runs the hub compiler and the register compiler after the Cards are written; limits come from the survey by the hub manager's rules; only on the live box (ztConfig empty). 2.5.1 (zt-digest 0.9.3): the first hubs round on the live box built 3 topic, 3 line and 2 field hubs and published a register of 93 terms pointing at specific Cards (42 before, all at Topic roots), hub check 0 faults; but it reported the register partial (the check prints its faults as a list) and wrote a second field hub, leaving the old 411/1|a unanchored (a new hub work folder knew no field hub). 2.5.1 counts a fault list and seeds the box's field hubs into the hub state before the plan, so the field writer keeps and updates them. 3.0.0: the sim adds the restatement round (one book) and tests/grow-workflow-harness.mjs checks mode hubs, the hub options and the restatement review. 3.1.0: the sim adds the Topic maintenance round (organize: true; one merge, one move) and the concept review of one book; tests/grow-workflow-harness.mjs checks both rounds, their order (restate -> organize -> concepts -> hubs), mode hubs with the concept review, and concepts false / organize false. 3.2.0: the sim answers the batched managers (grow restate mgr, grow concepts mgr); tests/grow-workflow-harness.mjs checks three books' judge jobs in one manager each, every prepare before the first judge, the books' order in the result, a failed prepare that skips only its book, and the box-copy log; grow.tests.ps1 plans a mathematics textbook's theorem unit as a section note.

runner.description: relays one zt-digest grow command and returns its last stdout line

out.description: the work folder: plan files, answers, state, report; also the DeepSeek workspace

books.description: the Literature trees to grow from (Citation keys); with neither books nor book, every Literature tree of the box

book.description: one Literature tree to grow from (its Citation key)

from.description: the first section (anchor number) to grow

to.description: the last section (anchor number) to grow

fixRounds.description: fix rounds after the first apply

dshModel.description: the DeepSeek Harness model (the official source)

ztConfig.description: the ZT_CONFIG_DIR of the box to grow: a copy of the box with its own zt service (empty: the live box)

tool.description: the zt-digest command, or the path of a zt-digest binary

hubs.description: run the hubs round: topic, line and field hubs for the grown Topics (hub compiler, DeepSeek writes each hub), then the register

register.description: the register after the hubs: rebuild and publish it from the box's term tables (apply), stage the plan only (plan), or leave it (off)

hubTrees.description: only these Topic trees get hubs (comma-separated Topic numbers; a pilot)

hubRebuild.description: rewrite every hub, not only the hubs of trees that changed

hubLimits.description: hub limits that replace the survey's (an object such as {"line_min": 12}; the hub compiler clamps them)

hubEffort.description: DeepSeek reasoning effort of the hub jobs

hubFixRounds.description: hub fix rounds after the first hub apply

restate.description: the restatement review of the run's new Topic Cards (zt-digest restate, one judge job per source book)

concepts.description: the concept review of each source book's term table against the Topics (zt-digest concepts, one judge job per book), read by the register plan as -Review; needs the hubs round and a register

organize.description: the Topic maintenance round before the hubs: duplicate-Topic merges and misplaced Topic Card moves on the run's Topics (one DeepSeek decision job, organize-apply -Open)

organizeTrees.description: the Topic trees the maintenance round surveys (comma-separated Topic numbers); empty: the Topics the run wrote in

stages.title: Grow
stages.detail: plan the sections, DeepSeek keeps the ideas, write the Topic Cards, link, check, fix, review restatements, maintain the Topics (optional), review each book's concepts, build the hubs and the register, report, clean up (mode hubs: only the concept review, the hubs and the register)

expect.message: the grow stage wrote no report
